note: Deterministic candidate for the shared-cart quantity oracle. The conflict path retains the existing quantity instead of adding the incoming quantity, so two concurrent adds converge to one line with quantity one instead of two.

mutations.desc: The cart upsert ignores an add that conflicts with an existing line.

edits.find: ON CONFLICT (cart_id, item_id) DO UPDATE SET quantity = cart_item.quantity + excluded.quantity
edits.replace: ON CONFLICT (cart_id, item_id) DO UPDATE SET quantity = cart_item.quantity
